items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Twist ये है' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. Each game place ('Vice City?', 'Grassrivers?') is asked like a quick quiz, then answered with delight. 'लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'एक टीला...' and 'नहीं... Tallahassee' are deadpan and funny. Numbers and English words (place names, state, million, coastline, lower forty-eight, game, map, fans, city, point, meter, capital) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. The last line trails off unfinished on 'क्योंकि सच बताऊं...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce 'Leonida' as 'lee-oh-NEE-dah', 'Kalaga' as 'kah-LAH-gah', 'Gellhorn' as 'GEL-horn', 'Tallahassee' as 'tal-uh-HASS-ee'. Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: अगर G-T-A six का Leonida... एक असली state होता?
Twist ये है: वो पहले से है। नाम है Florida.
Leonida Keys... असल में Florida Keys.
Grassrivers? Everglades... जिसे River of Grass कहते हैं।
और Port Gellhorn ऊपर Panhandle पर है।
तो इस state को क्या मिलेगा?
Twenty-three million से ज़्यादा लोग... America का तीसरा सबसे बड़ा state.
और lower forty-eight की सबसे लंबी coastline.
लेकिन एक पेंच है: game का map बहुत छोटा है।
Fans ने नापा: लगभग Miami city जितना।
असली Florida? One thousand गुना से भी बड़ा।
लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है।
Leonida में एक पहाड़ है: Mount Kalaga.
Florida का सबसे ऊंचा point? एक टीला... one hundred five meter.
America के किसी भी state का सबसे नीचा high point.
फिर capital. Vice City? नहीं... Tallahassee.
और Florida बस एक बात कहता है।
तो... Leonida या Florida? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
